group.name: Mods (each works alone; together they react to each other)

plugin.name: Bloodfeud
plugin.description: Nemesis-style feuds and faction wars. Enemies get names, memories and grudges; some cheat death or send kin after you; eight factions fight over Skyrim's holds; wounded enemies can be interrogated. Menu: F7.

plugin.name: Ledger
plugin.description: A living economy. Every hold has its own market that reacts to dangerous roads, the civil war, dragons, seasons and your trading. Merchants' prices, gold and stock change accordingly, and you can invest in businesses for weekly dividends. Menu: F8.
